items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 208:1
items.html: The Tree of Knowledge is in Assiyah, that is, the aspect of the Chazeh [chest] and downward, which is called Assiyah. And the essence of the Chazeh and downward is the middle line, which is Yesod, for Yesod is called a tree. And this is the secret of the wicked tree that cried out, "do not touch me". (Item 48).
